Interests

What draws my attention

Three areas, one connecting idea: understand how something works, then make that understanding useful.

A

Tools & technology

Practical AI, useful software, and the process of making things work. The interesting question is not just what a tool can do, but when it can be relied on.

Focus
Useful tools and practical AI
Approach
Build, test, refine
Read
What makes a tool trustworthy?
B

Decisions & learning

Evidence, uncertainty, and becoming better at difficult things. I am interested in the quality of the reasoning, not only the outcome it happens to produce.

Focus
Clearer thinking under uncertainty
Approach
Question, practice, update
Read
Good decisions, imperfect outcomes
C

Creative work & exploration

Writing, visual storytelling, and perspectives gained from trying something unfamiliar. Explaining an idea is often another way of finding out what still needs to be learned.

Focus
Ideas made understandable
Approach
Explore, make, communicate
